name: call.script
description: v1.0.0. Human-read cold call script or human-voice outreach (read aloud or typed by a person, not auto-sent). Judges truthfulness, specificity, one low-cost ask, no price or hype, speakable voice and a clear exit. Score the spoken body only, without DRAFT or metadata headers.

evidence_backed.instructions: Every statement about the prospect is a specific, checkable observation (what was checked, roughly when), and the script invents no statistics, losses, results, customers or outcomes it could not have observed

one_business.instructions: The script names one specific business or its website and an observation about it; it would not survive a find-and-replace to a different business

single_low_cost_ask.instructions: There is exactly one ask and it is low commitment for the listener (permission to send something free, or a yes/no), not a booked meeting, a purchase, or several asks

no_price_or_hype.instructions: The script contains no price, fee, discount or dollar figure, and no hype: no guarantees, superlatives, fake urgency or pressure

speakable_voice.instructions: Read aloud by a person, this sounds like natural conversation: short sentences, plain words, no marketing jargon or written-only phrasing

clear_exit.instructions: The listener is given an easy, explicit and polite way to say no and end the call, and the script accepts the no without pushing

rules.reason: unsupported or invented claim about the prospect
price or hype in a human-read script
no easy exit for the listener
generic script, not prepared for one business
does not read as natural speech

calibration.note: v1.0.0 authored 2026-10-22 by GTM Lead (Jake ruling q_3532f1d2dcb2). Thresholds 0.50 are initial; see fixtures/call.script-controls and CHANGELOG.md for the control run.

notes: Composite score for reporting = min of the six noul values (0-1). Global Jev >= 0.9 bar unchanged; this rubric's verdict is reported alongside it.
